classes.name: index
classes.reason: _consume reads each index file once but checks `if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True`, so the reads must finish inside the broadcast producer-time budget or the unit is recorded as dropped; the producers writing and the consumer reading are separate ranks doing their own work, so only the accessing rank blocks.

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: _report loops `for _pass in range(STATISTICS_READS)` doing plain probe.read_staged calls with no budget check, so the consumer rank simply stalls on each of its 8 reads per file while other ranks proceed with their own emit/loop work.
